title: Matterbridge Google Nest plugin
description: Google Nest (thermostats, cameras, doorbells, Protect) via the Smart Device Management API

projectId.title: Device Access Project ID
projectId.description: The Google Device Access project (enterprise) ID.

refreshToken.title: OAuth Refresh Token
refreshToken.description: OAuth 2.0 refresh token obtained with the sdm.service scope.

pollInterval.title: Poll Interval (s)
pollInterval.description: How often to poll the SDM API for device state, in seconds (minimum 30).

whiteList.title: White List
whiteList.description: Only the devices in the list will be exposed. If empty, all devices are exposed.

blackList.title: Black List
blackList.description: The devices in the list will not be exposed.

debug.title: Enable Debug
debug.description: Enable debug mode for the plugin.

unregisterOnShutdown.title: Unregister On Shutdown
unregisterOnShutdown.description: Unregister all devices on shutdown. For debugging only.
